items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: There was one incident; he talked about, who was it, Sidney Bechet said, he was gonna call his a dog, but that's what he did.

ctx.x: Well, yes. I'm of the school where we could play; we look at each other and we'd have an arrangement; I mean, you just have this feeling for one another.

But let me ask you this. Duke also talked about the messages that passed between musicians; he said the audience might not even be aware of it, but and this is early on, this is 20 years before what you were talking about -- people have messages between each other; they tell stories and have different things. There was one incident; he talked about, who was it, Sidney Bechet said, he was gonna call his a dog, but that's what he did. That's
the sound that he wanted to convey the message for.
